name: MYCRON
recent: Mycron Steel 于2026年10月28日完成以3000万令吉向母公司MIGB收购莎阿南工业地及厂房，其中2400万令吉由银行贷款支付。公司将于2026年12月2日召开第23届常年股东大会，提呈2026年报、董事费及 recurrent related party transactions 授权更新等议案。此外，公司于2026年10月15日公告一项重大诉讼。
notable: 以3000万令吉向母公司MIGB收购莎阿南工业地及厂房，交易已于2026年10月28日完成。
2026年9月8日特别股东大会通过上述关联方收购议案。
并提呈2026年常年股东大会。
risks: 公司于2026年10月15日公告一项重大诉讼。

Mycron’s RM30m Shah Alam property acquisition becomes unconditional
Mycron seeks shareholders’ nod for RM30m Shah Alam factory purchase from parent

recent_en: Mycron Steel completed its RM30 million acquisition of Shah Alam industrial land and buildings from parent MIGB on 28 October 2026, with RM24 million funded by a bank loan. Separately, the company announced a material litigation on 15 October 2026.
notable_en: Acquired Shah Alam industrial land and buildings from parent MIGB for RM30 million; the transaction completed on 28 October 2026.
Shareholders approved the related party acquisition at an EGM on 8 September 2026.
Proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, tabled at the 2026 AGM.
risks_en: The company announced a material litigation on 15 October 2026.
